articles.title: Greggs, Boots and M&S team up with Met Police to tackle shoplifters
articles.summary: Major retailers on London's high streets are using new technology from the Metropolitan Police to catch shoplifters. It allows them to submit CCTV footage, witness statements and other evidence directly to officers within minutes, allowing the biggest force in the country to track, arrest, and build cases against offenders more quickly. Tesco, Boots, Marks & Spencer and Greggs are among the retail giants already using the tech, which they access via subscription, across several London boroughs, including Westminster, Hammsersmith and Fulham, and Greenwich.
